verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms three.js is published on the npm registry as the package `three` (v0.186.0, MIT, ~12.2M weekly downloads), and the probe notes that coding agents drive the library directly through npm. The README shows it used as an imported library (`new THREE.WebGLRenderer`), and addons such as SVG and CSS3D renderers are available as separate imports. missing for 10: explicit evidence of tree-shaking/ES-module side-effect-free builds, documented bundler integration (e.g. Vite/webpack setup).

support.subject: As a web developer, the engine installs from a package registry into my existing toolchain — a library I import, bundle, and tree-shake like any dependency
